dataList.name: Portrait Bayangan Sighting
dataList.desc: Jika Skill Slot is attached to the Master's Portrait, a shockwave in the same color as the aura around the Master's Portrait occurs ketika the Portrait is revealed

dataList.name: Throwing Out the Interloper
dataList.desc:
Ketika the Portraits are present:
- Akhir Giliran: Once 3 giliran have passed since the Portraits have appeared...
     - Beri [UninvitedGuest] to the earliest-Deployed musuh tanpa [UninvitedGuest]
     - Incinerate semua Portraits. Beri double jumlah dari fake Portraits burned as [Sinking] Potency dan Count terhadap semua musuh. Peroleh [AttackUp] dan [Protection] giliran berikutnya

dataList.name: Interloper Hunt
dataList.desc: Jika target memiliki [UninvitedGuest], Clash Power +1 dan beri +20% damage

dataList.name: Ooh, Dear Master...
dataList.desc:
Ketika the Portraits are present, kurangi Affinity & Attack Type Resistances sebanyak 0.5, dan peroleh 8 [Protection].
Jika musuh dikalahkan the Master's Portrait, beri [UninvitedGuest] ke unit that dikalahkan it; lalu peroleh 0.5 Phys. Resistances dan 5 Fragile selama giliran berikutnya.

dataList.name: You Must Be the Interloper's Family?
dataList.desc: Ketika musuh has [UninvitedGuest], beri [UninvitedGuest] terhadap musuh tanpa [UninvitedGuest] setiap kali unit ini kehilangan 10% of its HP (maks 4 musuh)

dataList.name: Peering Tatapan
dataList.desc: As long as unit ini exists, beri 1 [Sinking] Potency dan Count setiap giliran

dataList.name: Interloper
dataList.desc:
Ketika unit ini dikalahkan, beri [UninvitedGuest] terhadap musuh that attacked unit ini last
- Jika 4+ musuh have [UninvitedGuest], efek ini tidak mengaktifkan

dataList.name: A Familiar Connector
dataList.desc:
Untuk setiap [ConnectedPlug], peroleh 1 Min. Speed value, 1 [Vulnerable], dan 1 [AttackDmgUp]
Ketika unit ini kena Stagger giliran berikutnya karena having 3 [ConnectedPlug], peroleh 4 [Vulnerable]

dataList.name: Overcurrent
dataList.desc: Akhir Giliran: Untuk setiap 10 [Charge] Count pada diri sendiri, peroleh 1 [VioletDamageUp] giliran berikutnya (maks 2)

dataList.name: Want to be Free
dataList.desc:
Pada 25% HP, starting giliran ini, peroleh 1 dari berikut setiap giliran. The values are cumulative dan do not kadaluarsa.
- Peroleh 1 [ParryingResultUp]
- Peroleh 1 [AttackDmgUp]
- Peroleh 1 [Vulnerable]

dataList.name: Generator
dataList.desc: Akhir Giliran: Jika unit ini tidak memiliki [ConnectedPlug] dan [ThundercloudFormation], summon a Generator sekali giliran berikutnya.

dataList.name: Gathering Lightning Cloud
dataList.desc:
Akhir Giliran: Beri 4 [ThundercloudFormation] to the Dreaming Electric Sheep giliran berikutnya.
Does not beri lebih dari efek ini jika it sudah has efek ini.

dataList.name: Detached Anti-Ovine Grounding Plug
dataList.desc: Ketika diserang, beri 1 [AntiSheepGround] to the Penyerang (sekali per giliran)

dataList.name: Safety Plug
dataList.desc: Reduces semua damage diterima ke 0

dataList.name: Prelude of the Banquet
dataList.desc:
Giliran 2 Start: Summon the retinue of the King in Binds.
The King has twelve retainers. Upon the kematian of a retainer, another will fill its place hingga terdapat none.

dataList.name: Closing of the Banquet
dataList.desc: Ketika semua retainers are dikalahkan, the King joins the fight.

dataList.name: Snapping Bandages
dataList.desc: Ketika Bagian "Tubuh" telah dihancurkan, beri [BandageOfTheBoundKing] pada semua musuh.

dataList.name: Retainer of the King in Binds
dataList.desc:
- Peroleh [BandageOfTheBoundKing] dan [BigWelcome] untuk Pertempuran ini.
- Pada setiap Awal Giliran, the King in Binds blesses unit ini dengan grace.
- The grace of the King in Binds changes setiap giliran, in berikut order: [Enhancement], SP Pulihkan, dan HP Pulihkan. Jika terdapat kurang dari 6 surviving Retainers(Peccatulum Invidiae), boost the grace's strength.
